gold_sql:
SELECT p.*, elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-111.815958 34.860895)',4326)::geography, 2500)
  AND p.amenity = 'cafe'
  AND elev.z >= 20;

buffer_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(inn_geom.geom, 2500) AS geom
  FROM inn_geom
),
elevation_check AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Value(rast, ST_Transform(buffer_geom.geom, 4326)::geometry) AS elevation
  FROM 
    buffer_geom, public.dem_us
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(rast, ST_Transform(buffer_geom.geom, 4326)::geometry)
)
SELECT 
  'Aroma, Burlingame, CA' AS cafe_name,
  CASE 
    WHEN elevation >= 20 THEN 'Elevation requirement met'
    ELSE 'Elevation requirement not met'
  END AS elevation_status
FROM 
  elevation_check, cafe_geom
WHERE 
  ST_Distance(inn_geom.geom, cafe_geom.geom) = 2500;
